founder.name: Owner
founder.body:
Lumi Liv started with a simple idea — that gifts should feel personal, not generic. Every piece that leaves our workshop is cut, engraved, and finished by hand, made exactly the way you imagined it.

Thank you for letting us be part of your celebrations.

services.heading: Our Services.
services.intro: One thread runs through everything we make. Bring us your idea — in leather, acrylic, or anything in between — and we'll cut, engrave, and stitch it into shape.

items.title: Laser Cutting
items.body: Precise custom cuts in leather, acrylic, wood, and more — however intricate the design.

items.title: Engraving
items.body: Fine detail engraved into metal, acrylic, and leather alike.

items.title: Stitching
items.body: Hand-stitched seams and finishes, built to last — not just look good.

items.title: Custom Design
items.body: Send a sketch, a photo, or just an idea — we'll turn it into a finished piece, made to order.

gallery.heading: A few things we've made — in leather, acrylic, and everything in between.

banner.text: Got something in mind? If you can sketch it, we can cut it.

lifestyle.text: Follow along for behind-the-scenes and finished pieces. From color picks to custom requests, your ideas help shape what we make next.

items.heading: Information We Collect
items.body: When you enquire, place an order, or contact us, we collect basic details you provide — your name, phone number, email, shipping address, and any custom design details you share with us.

items.heading: How We Use It
items.body: We use your information only to process orders, respond to enquiries, arrange delivery, and occasionally share updates about new collections if you've opted in.

items.heading: Sharing With Third Parties
items.body: We don't sell your information. We only share what's necessary with delivery partners and payment processors to complete your order.

items.heading: Cookies
items.body: This site may use basic cookies to remember preferences and understand how visitors use the site. No sensitive data is stored this way.

items.heading: Data Security
items.body: We take reasonable steps to protect your information, but no online system is ever 100% secure. Please avoid sharing sensitive payment details over chat or email.

items.heading: Your Rights
items.body: You can request to see, correct, or delete the information we hold about you at any time by reaching out to us directly.

items.heading: Custom Orders
items.body: Custom and made-to-order pieces are crafted specifically to your specifications. Please review your design details carefully before confirming — production begins shortly after approval.

items.heading: Payment
items.body: Full or partial advance payment may be required before production begins on custom orders, as communicated to you at the time of enquiry.

items.heading: Shipping & Delivery
items.body: Timelines vary by product and customization complexity. We'll share an estimated delivery window when your order is confirmed.

items.heading: Returns & Exchanges
items.body: Because most pieces are made to order, custom items are generally not eligible for return or exchange unless there's a manufacturing defect.

items.heading: Intellectual Property
items.body: All designs, branding, and product photography on this site belong to Lumi Liv and may not be reproduced without permission.

items.heading: Limitation of Liability
items.body: We aim for accuracy in every piece we make, but minor natural variation is normal in handcrafted leather and acrylic work and isn't considered a defect.
